notes:
Overview:
- Mid-market/enterprise fintech focused on credit decisioning and user support. Heavy compliance (data residency, audit).
- Primary interest: private deployment behind VPC for latency and data controls; dedicated GPUs for reranking and embeddings.

Recent timeline / activities:
- 2024-09-12: Intro call (AE Maya) — product fit looks strong; asked for POC scope.
- 2024-10-02: POC kickoff; SE Diego created repo template and onboarding checklist. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/NSCL-procurement-2024
- 2024-10-15: Demo (Fireflies FF-20241015-NSCL-demo) — showed latency numbers and batching options. CIO said: "We need full audit trails + SAML before pilot."
- 2024-11-02: Security deep-dive (Fireflies FF-20241102-security-call). Security team raised concerns about lack of server-side token lifecycle and missing tracing hooks for APM. Logged RD-7894 and RD-8012.
- 2024-11-20: SE delivered integration notes; engineering team attempted SDK PoC but ran into auth flow gaps (no automated refresh + no trace/span injection). Ticket RD-8240 created.
- 2024-12-05: Procurement emailed (thread-CAJxY2_nscl_2024demo) — budget freeze announced for Q1; requested roadmap items and security SLA.
- 2025-01-18: Went dark after two attempts to schedule a follow-up; later intel from reseller indicates they selected competitor who offered pre-built SAML + centralized audit logs.

Quotes / buyer color:
- CIO: "We won't sign without SAML and immutable audit logs."
- Head of Eng: "SDK is promising but we can't rework auth across services for the POC window."

POC details and technical blockers:
- POC target: reranking pipeline + support agent embeddings at 50 qps with <120ms tail latency.
- Key blockers: SDK doesn't ship server-side token refresh or documented webhook for cache invalidation; no built-in tracing integration for Datadog/NewRelic; security wants KMS/HSM integration + retention controls.

Next steps attempted / owner notes:
- SE (Diego): proposed an SDK PR that adds server-side refresh + example middleware, and a short observability shim for span injection. Deliverable estimated 3 weeks.
- AE (Maya): requested extended trial and security addendum; pushed pricing deck (drive link above).
- Business ops: flagged as high ARR potential but high org risk due to procurement freeze and champion turnover.

Recommended playbook if re-engage:
- Deliver minimal SDK auth patch + example app in customer's stack (Spring Boot).
- Provide security-runbook + SOC2/ISO artifacts and a test audit log export.
- Offer 6-week POC with clear acceptance criteria around SAML + audit evidence.

Current disposition: stalled / effectively closed-lost; re-engage window target 2025-09 for budget cycle.
